lines.x: Cleaning duty? Sure, no problem. Hmm... Maybe I'll find some decorations and change up the mood of the classroom.

On the way to school today, I actually found gerberas at a flower shop in town—though the name seemed a little different... Anyway, I brought a bunch. Doctor, may I put them here? A splash of color always lifts the mood.
Sigh... Doctor, is there a range in Laterano just for archery? I still can't get used to gunshots going off right beside me while I'm drawing my bow...
Dr.{@nickname}, you always look so calm. That air of being unmoved by anything—it's really impressive. I wish I could learn it... Huh? All I need is a hood? ...Now that you mention it, maybe so...

I was thinking of cooking for myself in the dorm tonight. Amiya came over the other day and taught me a few Lateran dishes. Besides, I bought way too much again at the market yesterday... Why don't you and Amiya come over tonight and eat with me?

Everyone was talking about vacations between classes. Honestly, I'd love to travel with everyone again. We've been to the sea before, so maybe the mountains this time... Are there any mountains near Laterano? If we ever get the chance, I'd love for you to take us—will we, I wonder...

Honestly, I'm not very good with people older than me. Ordinary teachers are fine, but when it's someone closer than that... Luckily, you don't make me feel that kind of tension. In that way, you're a bit like our leader.
I ran into Lisa's mother on the way home yesterday—she turned out to be such a cool woman! And the two of them get along so well... I felt a little envious.

"I have to live on my own"—I used to think that way, too... But staying sunk in that kind of feeling, pushing everyone away, isn't good for you... Neither I nor anyone else is really as strong as all that.
I'm getting a little sleepy too. Maybe I'll take a short nap...
My name is Yukari Takeba. I'll be studying here for a while. My specialty is archery—which maybe sounds a little dangerous, put like that...? Anyway, nice to meet you all!
Hmm... If we're watching something, I'd rather have a show that lets you relax a bit.
My grades have always been decent, but this is the first time I've gotten an award like this! Maybe we should all celebrate after school today... You'll come too, right, Doctor?

This medal looks rather valuable... I'm only a student, is it really alright for me to accept it...? Ah, no, nothing! I'll work hard to be worthy of the honor. Thank you so much for recognizing me, Dr.{@nickname}.
You'll be coaching our training, Doctor? I'm looking forward to it.
Huh, me...? Surely there's someone better suited... I mean—no problem. Leave it to me.
How many floors will we climb today...? No—how far will we have to go?
No problem—I'm all set.
Focus...
What should I do...?
Is this the place...?
This distance is just right!
Persona！
Isis... lend me your strength!
I'm not alone anymore...!
I won't let you hurt my friends!
Whew... I'd like a break... Doctor, wasn't that a bit much to ask of us just now...? Huh, you had faith in me? Excuse me, is that part of your command technique too...?
...Doctor, you look impressive when you're directing a battle, but also a little scary. Did you do some other kind of work before you became a teacher...?
Ah... yeah, actually, isn't it fine if it's not quite perfect?
I'm sorry... Was I holding everyone back? Please tell me what I need to fix. Next time... it won't happen again.
Does that mean we can rest here? Yes!
Oh, Doctor? Did you need something?
Oh, it's you, Doctor. Want to go shopping together later?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Doctor! The Reliquary really is packed today, isn't it? The graffiti on the relic keeps getting thicker, too... Well, praying to a god isn't a bad thing, but I think a wish is better when you work to make it come true yourself. What do you think, Doctor?
Good morning, Dr.{@nickname}. Is that today's handout? I can pass them out to everyone.

Happy birthday, Dr.{@nickname}! Today's party is all yours. I'll leave the last step of the cake to you—here's the piping bag. Write something on it! Or draw, if you'd rather. Pretty good idea, right?

Huh...? I slipped away because the festival was too noisy—I wanted somewhere quiet. What are you doing here, Doctor? You're the guest of honor today, aren't you...? Fine, fine. Let's rest here together for a bit, then...
